title: Rev5.8 Objective Projection & Evidence Admission

compatibility.policy: Core contracts are exact and compatibility inside the Core is suspicious. Provider, environment and domain variability belongs behind adapters/capabilities and must normalize into one canonical Core contract.
compatibility.future_structured_output: Provider adapters may support multiple provider-native structured-output mechanisms in the future, but each adapter must normalize them into the single canonical Agent/Claim profile before Core validation; no silent Core downgrade path.

architecture.main_llm: Owns task semantics, Investigation, relevance, Evidence admission, materiality and stopping. It chooses capabilities, explicitly promotes material src-* SourceRecords through Investigation/Final grounding, and decides whether objective frontiers matter.
architecture.runtime: Owns physical/structural authority: deterministic capability execution, SourceRecord identity/freshness, objective projection, coverage/frontiers/handles, schemas, replay, budgets, transactions and security. It never ranks semantic relevance or promotes SourceRecords by inferred usefulness.
architecture.claim: One independent semantic review over the canonical request, literal request/answer anchors, admitted Evidence, Runtime Facts and Investigation. Runtime validates coordinate existence and protocol invariants; Claim decides semantic satisfaction.
architecture.grounded_outcomes: material_satisfaction is satisfied|gap|blocked. Physical blockage is a valid truthful outcome when supported by Runtime Facts; semantic gaps state required_property without prescribing tools.
architecture.investigation: Optional persistent semantic debt declared only by the Main LLM. Runtime mechanically preserves identity, goals, Evidence binding and legal transitions.
architecture.observation_map: Derived from ObservationLedger; Runtime Facts for Claim are bounded projections of objective current-job observations, not a second factual ledger.
architecture.tool_registry: TOOLS is the sole executable registry. Every capability exposes compact/full contracts plus a domain-neutral effect class (observe|execute|mutate). Progressive capability_index/active_tools remains selector-free.
architecture.terminal_capabilities: ExecutionContext records physically terminal capability failures for the current job. Handle-specific HANDLE_NOT_FOUND/HANDLE_STALE failures are continuation-reference failures and never retire expand_observation.
architecture.structured_transport: Agent and Claim require strict JSON Schema. Claim grounding arrays are non-empty in the canonical schema/parser contract; no downgrade, repair call or truncation retry exists.
architecture.state_ownership: ObservationLedger owns physical tool reality/replay/coverage; SourceRecordLedger owns objectively materialized citable source records; EvidenceLedger owns only Main-admitted Evidence plus narrow Runtime validation facts; DecisionLedger owns decisions/rejections; LLMCallLedger owns calls; WriteTransaction owns mutations; ExecutionContext owns job resources.
architecture.sandbox: backend=auto prefers Docker and falls back to Bubblewrap. Docker uses one persistent disposable container per job with a writable project snapshot and network/toolchain freedom. The real workspace is never mounted read-write. Only explicit protected resources and their symlink/hard-link aliases are omitted; normal source is preserved regardless of secret-like content.
architecture.writes: One WriteTransaction owns proposal, dry-run, confirmation, apply, validation, failure and rollback. Sandbox mutations never authorize workspace writes.
architecture.final: One canonical object: answer, limitations and grounding ids. Main may select src-* records; Runtime deterministically promotes only those explicit selections to ev-src-* before final validation/Claim.
architecture.structural_relations: symbol_relations keeps query=relations as the local structural view and query=reachability as the directed path view. Reachability exhausts the finite resolved graph mechanically, resolves local/import bindings before global fallback, and does not expose LLM-tuned depth boundaries.
architecture.observation_contract: Every executed tool result uses one canonical envelope: physical status fields plus observations, coverage, frontiers and handles. Empty optional observation fields are legal; tools are not forced to invent frontier state.
architecture.observation_handles: Opaque handle:* IDs address bounded observation snapshots. expand_observation accepts only the handle namespace; Evidence/Observation IDs are rejected before execution. Missing/stale handles invalidate one continuation reference, not the capability.
architecture.directed_observation: Directed reachability materializes complete resolved paths automatically. Negative queries expose expandable frontiers only when unresolved sites carry target-directed corridor evidence; generic root-side dynamic dispatch is one non-expandable boundary limitation.
architecture.context_projection: Canonical world/task state remains complete in ledgers. Main prompts receive a hot projection: bounded recent/pinned Evidence and Observation indexes, only the two most recent expanded tool contracts, and bounded current-delta tool results. Older capabilities remain callable through the compact capability index.
architecture.claim_projection: Claim grounding is projected by Main authority: final.evidence_ids plus Evidence explicitly attached to Investigation. Runtime validates IDs and freshness but does not infer semantic relevance.
architecture.conversation_boundary: Runtime normalizes stored/UI conversation records into one Core message shape: {role, content}. Core does not accept text/content aliases.
architecture.pending_continuation: Pending continuation uses independent exact pending_schema_version=1 with English field names and exact kind-specific shapes; older or alternate envelopes are rejected, never migrated.
architecture.search_code: ripgrep and Python fallback operate over the same deterministic file universe and share one canonical ranking/truncation stage; backend choice may change performance but not observable candidate semantics.
architecture.workspace_security: Rev5.8 retains the Rev5.7.7 physical protected-resource identity boundary: explicit secret-resource paths plus symlink/hard-link identity, no content-based secret classifier.
architecture.objective_projection: Capabilities may exhaust an objectively specified property over large state and deterministically compress, group and paginate it. coverage_complete describes the capability search scope; projection_complete describes only the bounded inline materialization. No hidden relevance model selects semantically important results.
architecture.evidence_admission: Tool success creates SourceRecords, not Evidence. Main explicitly selects material src-* records in Investigation or Final; Runtime performs identity-preserving promotion only. Navigation breadcrumbs can remain unpromoted without polluting EvidenceLedger.
architecture.search_projection: search_code exhausts the readable literal-match universe mechanically, groups all ranges, diversifies deterministically across files before model-facing limits, and exposes omitted objective ranges through opaque continuation handles.
